[{"label":"a","letter":"a","text":"The lengths of two sides of a triangle are 19 cm and 20 cm respectively, and the included angle is \(45^\circ\). Determine the area of the triangle.","marks":0,"answer":"Area of triangle:
\[
\frac{1}{2} \times 19 \times 20 \times \sin 45^\circ = 190 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{190\sqrt{2}}{2} = 95\sqrt{2} \approx 134.35 \text{ sq.cm}
\]","image":"https://idgogbisqacywbfnhdzy.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/question-images/1767608901013_tm8n4.jpeg","image_url":"https://idgogbisqacywbfnhdzy.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/question-images/1767608901013_tm8n4.jpeg"},{"label":"b","letter":"b","text":"Determine the length and breadth of the rectangular solid.","marks":0,"answer":"Let length = \(a\) m, breadth = \(b\) m.
Given \(ab = 48\) and diagonal \(\sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + 3^2} = 13 \Rightarrow a^2 + b^2 + 9 = 169 \Rightarrow a^2 + b^2 = 160\).
Now, \((a+b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 + 2ab = 160 + 96 = 256 \Rightarrow a+b = 16\).
\((a-b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab = 160 - 96 = 64 \Rightarrow a-b = 8\) (since \(a > b\)).
Solving: \(2a = 24 \Rightarrow a = 12\), then \(b = 4\).","image":"https://idgogbisqacywbfnhdzy.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/question-images/1767608901020_3lib3t.jpeg","image_url":"https://idgogbisqacywbfnhdzy.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/question-images/1767608901020_3lib3t.jpeg"},{"label":"c","letter":"c","text":"An iron pipe of 5 cm height is made using the length and breadth of the rectangular solid as outer and inner diameters respectively. If the weight of each cubic cm of iron is 7.2 gm, determine the weight of the pipe.","marks":0,"answer":"Inner diameter = 4 m ⇒ radius \(r_1 = 2\) m. Outer diameter = 12 m ⇒ radius \(r_2 = 6\) m. Height \(h = 5\) cm = 0.05 m.
Volume of iron:
\[
\pi h (r_2^2 - r_1^2) = 3.1416 \times 0.05 \times (36 - 4) = 3.1416 \times 0.05 \times 32 = 5.02656 \text{ m}^3 = 5026560 \text{ cm}^3
\]
Weight: \(5026560 \times 7.2 = 36191232 \text{ gm} = 36191.232 \text{ kg}\).
","image":null,"image_url":null}]
